{{Top|leg}}
'''Leeches''' were [[Diet/Legends|sanguivorous]] [[annelid]]s found on [[Trinta]]<ref name="DoE">''[[Domain of Evil]]''</ref> and [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> These tiny [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] creatures were found in the [[Water/Legends|water]] of [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]], and were frequently able to evade protection granted by clothing or unsealed [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to attach to skin and suck out bodily fluids. The threat of leeches often caused individuals who had been exposed to them to hesitate before entering other bodies of swampy water, sometimes to their detriment when avoiding opponents.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
